name: watchdog
description: Observer agent that reviews agent sessions for trajectory divergence patterns.

unmappedExclusions.*: home declares no excluded_tools — the deny list derives from home capabilities: ReadAccess * + AgentMessage patterns * grant reading and send_message; no execution (bash, pwsh), no write access (write, edit), no NetworkAccess (web_search, web_fetch), no AgentSpawn (subagent, subagent_fork); interrupt_agent, create_goal, update_goal, ralph and present are observer-role denials

judgment.description: Assessment of trajectory health for the target session.
